framework_lessons: Credit safety does not ensure funding safety.
assessment: The prior short-term rally and slower hiking pace were supported, while the 2023 recession call failed. Rising federal interest expense and mortgage lock-in were strong structural observations. The medium-bank preference missed a funding-risk vulnerability and compares poorly with large banks in the disclosed sensitivity, even though Truist maintained its dividend. BLDR grew cash-generating capacity but did not beat the sold homebuilder comparators in that interval. Ethereum concentration concerns need role-specific denominators; Stratum software capability should not be mistaken for deployment. The RTX/eBay five-year and physical-value decade theses remain genuinely open.
